title: Granby River
sub: Grand Forks, BC · WSC 08NN002 + Burrell Creek 08NN023 · Billings climate
blurb: A warm El Niño winter. The gauge flagged ice on only 28 days, in broken episodes, and the freshet came early and small: 147 m³/s, against 465 in the 2010–24 record.
name: granby_wy2024

lanes.label: Granby River flow
lanes.does: Piano gets denser as flow rises; contrabass holds the root, cello adds a 5th at high flow.

lanes.label: Flow vs. 15-yr normal
lanes.does: Sets the harmony's brightness: below normal leans one mode darker, above normal one brighter.

lanes.label: Burrell Creek flow
lanes.does: Hand drums: tumba, conga, shaker, and a 3-3-2 log-drum figure at the peak.

lanes.label: Ice conditions (WSC flag)
lanes.does: Freeze: falling glockenspiel + bowed cymbal. Frozen: crackle and descending singing-ice chirps. Breakup: cymbal swell and rising harp.

lanes.label: Air temperature, Billings
lanes.does: Colder days make the ice crackle denser; also brightens the harmony across the season.

lanes.label: Rain
lanes.does: Each rainy day scatters harp notes from the current chord.

lanes.label: Snowfall
lanes.does: Snowfall scatters soft glockenspiel notes, high up.

lanes.label: Snow on ground
lanes.does: Deep snow swaps the reverb to a dark, short room: snow absorbs sound.

lanes.label: Redband trout spawning
lanes.does: A short rising flute figure. Timing is modelled from temperature and season.

lanes.label: Mountain whitefish spawning
lanes.does: A falling cello pizzicato figure. Timing is modelled.

lanes.label: Day length
lanes.does: With temperature, sets how bright the mode is.
